items.summary: Financial recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, monetization expansion, or new queue work. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 Amazon results: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under tracking ID "other"; it is not site-attributable. AI usage is $947.3986 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 across 5,289 calls, but infrastructure and other costs are unavailable and periods do not match, so contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, and forecasts are not calculable. Continue the existing period-aligned reconciliation, deployed-work measurement, repair-or-close containment, and readiness work only. Minimum finance evidence is a dated ledger matching each revenue and cost item to the same site/content and period, including AI, hosting, infrastructure, domain, and other operating costs, plus an approved learning threshold.

Reject the deferred affiliate CTA experiment as a retained proposal this cycle. The existing allthingsmasonic.com request may remain in its current queue state, but 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21 do not establish revenue potential or causal lift. Do not use the $4.92 aggregate provider commission for site-level claims, and do not compare one revenue day with September AI spend.
